title: Felix and the Horizon Revisited
author: Vesper Brightwater
blurb: Wren Eriksen, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
